items.title: 8.13 Dabao ya hajm ki tabdeeli ka asar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.13, printed pages 180-181, with the first Quick Check 8.6.

blocks.text: Volume ya pressure badalne ka asar in soorton mein nahi hota:

items: Jab system mein koi gas shamil na ho.
Jab gas phase ke homogeneous equilibrium mein reactants aur products ke moles barabar hon.

blocks.text: Yeh asar sirf tab hota hai jab reactants aur products ki gas ke moles barabar na hon.
Is asar ko samajhne ke liye Haber process se ammonia banana dekhein.
a) Pressure barhana ya volume kam karna:

Forward reaction mein gas ke moles 4 se 2 ho jate hain, is liye volume kam hota hai. Equilibrium par mixture shuru ke muqable kam volume gherta hai. Is liye equilibrium par pressure barhane se aur ammonia banti hai, yani reaction forward taraf shift hoti hai.
b) Pressure kam karna ya volume barhana:
Pressure kam karne ya volume barhane se reaction us taraf jati hai jahan zyada volume ho (zyada gas moles). Ammonia ki reaction reverse taraf shift hoti hai.
In reactions mein volume ya pressure badalne se sirf equilibrium ki position badalti hai, equilibrium constant nahi. Har reaction ki direction kaise badlegi?

blocks.caption: Pressure aur volume ki tabdeeli (Quick Check 8.6 ke jawab)

blocks.prompt: Kis gaseous equilibrium par pressure ka koi asar nahi: 2NO₂ ⇌ N₂O₄; PCl₅ ⇌ PCl₃ + Cl₂; CO + H₂O ⇌ CO₂ + H₂; 2SO₂ + O₂ ⇌ 2SO₃?
blocks.explanation: CO + H₂O ⇌ CO₂ + H₂, kyun ke dono taraf gas ke 2 moles hain; pressure ya volume badalne ka asar dono taraf barabar hai. Baqi teeno mein gas moles badalte hain, is liye woh pressure se shift hoti hain.

items: Pressure ya volume ka asar sirf tab jab gas moles barabar na hon.
Zyada pressure (kam volume): kam gas moles wali taraf (ammonia: forward). Kam pressure: zyada gas moles wali taraf.
